title: Dandelions pop in such hurry petals stretching seeking needing to lick lips smacking from our sun Like Me creatures of creative fury and fire unleashe
summary: Dandelions pop in such hurry petals stretching seeking needing to lick lips smacking from our sun Like Me creatures of creative fury and fire unleashed we burn in fields of fallen desire #smallpoems #poemsofpresence
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Dandelions
pop in such hurry

     petals stretching
  seeking
needing
to lick lips
smacking from our
sun

Like Me
creatures of
creative
   fury and
fire
unleashed we
   burn
in fields of
fallen desire
#smallpoems
#poemsofpresence
